notes: PC-first spAnimation lifetime/storage and spAnimationSerializer read/write reconnaissance; PS2 deliberately deferred.

classes.summary: PC SAN timing/interpolation/name binding plus native track stride, track/tag storage and destruction are known; controller prefix, constructor defaults, evaluator tick and PS2 remain open.

evidence.observation: Native tracks use a 0x44 stride; the object owns a track array, sorted tag pointer vector, six auxiliary buffers and another payload, and unregisters bound tracks before destruction.
Pinned PC body hashes and vtables confirm identity, ownership offsets, track stride, tag ordering and the native serializer boundary.
PC runtime binding is case-sensitive, tolerates missing targets and applies all-target binding to duplicate node names; final evaluator tick is still unobserved.

classes.summary: PC identity, source path, target, vtables and complete reader/writer bodies are pinned; rare fields 5..12, key encoding names, portable stream mutation/rollback and PS2 remain open.

evidence.observation: spAnimationSerializer directly derives from spSerializer, targets class 0x56EE563A, and preserves the exact spAnimationSerializer.cpp translation-unit path.
Native read/write covers PRS tracks, tags and shared time-key fields 0..12 plus control field 64; helper logic confirms multiple value sizes and key encodings.
The existing PC SAN decoder is valid for the observed core subset but is not yet a complete native serializer replacement.
